Name: Beach Extension For Crab Pod
Author: tikamin557
Description:
We were concerned about the pollution of the beach with crab pods, so we built a aquaculture farm (crab pod yard).
Head there by boat and return by boat.

Patterns can be selected from the mod config!

I have created a mod to add storage space that can be accessed from this mod.
You can use them together if you'd like!
[size=5]”[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14244]Beach Additional Storage Space Area[/url]”[/size]
